items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: Roz Metzger. We had two pianos. Roz Metzger, who went on and became quite a darn good piano.

ctx.x: Do you remember anybody in the San Band of that period?

I think Bill Tell, a banjo player, who later played with those Vocalion Wolverines records, was one. I'd have a lot of trouble putting it. Oh, Roz Metzger. We had two pianos. Roz Metzger, who went on and became quite a darn good piano. He's now president of Footcone and Bellingham. It was led by a violinist, like the Ramblers.
